# Shibumi Shell 0.1.1-beta.8

This prerelease adds optional per-generation layout locks, compacts the Bars controls, and hardens managed updates without taking ownership of Omarchy's transparency preference.

Update an existing source installation:

```bash
cd Shibumi-Shell
git pull --ff-only
./scripts/shibumi-suite update --yes
```

> AUR publication remains pending because registration is currently unavailable.

## What changed

- Lock V1 and V2 layouts independently while retaining Edit slots/layout as a temporary override
- Present Edit, Lock, and Restore side by side for the active generation, with a visible toggle state
- Keep Shibumi V1/V2 opaque while preserving `bar.transparent` exclusively for the stock Omarchy bar
- Add V1/V2 widget appearance controls and clearer transfer/reset actions
- Surface Omarchy Agents usage and third-party plugin update status

## Update and lifecycle fixes

- Drain the managed Quickshell process before replacing plugin payloads
- Refuse updates while the Omarchy session lock is active
- Enforce exclusive bar-widget ownership and harden output teardown
- Restore the Omarchy plugin diff pager and close update panels before launching external review or update actions
- Select `omarchy.agents` when current hosts no longer ship the legacy model-usage providers
- Keep Network speed tests entirely inline by running `omarchy-network-speedtest` from Shibumi without loading Omarchy's standalone speed-test panel

## Compatibility and release limits

- Existing V1/V2 layouts remain directly editable because both locks default off
- Existing `bar.transparent` values remain untouched and are not materialized when absent
- The suite remains 24 native Omarchy plugins in one Quickshell process
- Physical mixed-scale multi-monitor, enterprise Wi-Fi, remaining device-backed Bluetooth, clean-chroot packaging, and safe nested-compositor checks remain explicit external stable gates

Full Changelog: [`v0.1.1-beta.7...v0.1.1-beta.8`](https://github.com/HANCORE-linux/Shibumi-Shell/compare/v0.1.1-beta.7...v0.1.1-beta.8)
